example.title: Tull Bridge (Brown's Ferry / Pryor's Ford Bridge), County Road 5 over the Saline River

brief: Single-span, seven-panel pin-connected steel Pratt through truss, 130 ft long, trusses 22 ft high and 15 ft apart over a 14 ft roadway, standing on pairs of concrete-filled steel cylinder piers with a short steel-stringer approach span at each end. Parallel chords; laced channel top chord and end posts, forged eyebar bottom chords, loop-ended bar diagonals and turnbuckled counters in the centre panel, laced-angle overhead struts; floor beams hung from the pins on U-bolts under five lines of stringers and a transverse plank deck, with a light angle rail along the trusses. By 2007 it was bypassed by a newer concrete bridge alongside, planks missing and the portal barricaded with a hazard board (the model should show it in service, planked).

names.plate: 1916 · KETTLE RIVER · BUILT BY THE OKLAHOMA-PLAINS BRIDGE CO. · COUNTY COURT
